BiblicalUsage: To push down is to thrust away, and the psalm asks that the angel of the LORD chase the enemy and drive them down. The wicked is driven away in his wickedness, and Isaiah says God will gather the outcasts of Israel from the four corners. Jeremiah says the false prophets' way will be slippery, and they will be driven on and fall. The word is the push of judgment, and the gathering of grace.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the pushing down of the wicked and the gathering of the outcasts are two sides of one judgment. God drives away those who will not turn, and He gathers those who will. My position is that the same hand that pushes down the proud lifts up the humble.
